_note: Plain-word definitions for codes and acronyms shown as chips. Register codes (G14, E-17) and rule codes (CAP-05, BR-01) are defined from their own registers at render time, not here.

P-5c.text: Budget exhibit P-5c, Ship Cost Analysis: the Navy's line-by-line cost of one ship in the President's Budget

MSAR.text: Major Defense Acquisition Program Selected Acquisition Report: the annual cost, schedule and performance report to Congress

SAR.text: Selected Acquisition Report, the annual report to Congress on a major acquisition program

SCN.text: Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy: the appropriation that funds new ships

PB.text: President's Budget request for a fiscal year

CIP.text: Construction in progress: the asset account that holds a ship's cost until it is placed in service

GFE.text: Government-furnished equipment: equipment the government buys and provides to the shipbuilder

GFP.text: Government-furnished property held by a contractor

FBwT.text: Fund Balance with Treasury: an agency's cash account at Treasury, a long-standing DoD audit weakness

FMO.text: Financial Management Operations office (Navy FMO, OUSD(C) FMO)

PEO.text: Program Executive Officer: the acquisition executive over a portfolio of programs (PEO Carriers for the Ford class)

CAPE.text: Cost Assessment and Program Evaluation, the OSD office that makes independent cost estimates

DCFO.text: Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Department of Defense

HII.text: Huntington Ingalls Industries, owner of Newport News Shipbuilding, CVN-79's builder

FPDS.text: Federal Procurement Data System: the government's record of contract actions

File C.text: USAspending File C: award-level obligations and outlays reported by the agency each period

Zone V.text: A figure tied to a source record and released for use; anything else is shown as a lead (rule BR-01)

MCP.text: Model Context Protocol: the standard way an AI agent calls a governed tool

UC.text: Unity Catalog, the Databricks governance layer for tables, volumes and models
